findings.message: SPEC-1 regex matches only markdown-bold `**not**` — a stale claim written with plain-text 'not migrated' (no asterisks) escapes the guard; introduced by this change.

SPEC-4 wraps its body in `if [[ -f "$_rl_guard" ]]` with no else branch, so if plugin.sh is deleted the block emits no assertion and silently passes; mitigated by SPEC-2 which does fail loudly on absence.
